title: lobelia portoricensis
intro: Lobelia portoricensis, commonly known as Portorican Lobelia or Puerto Rican Lobelia, is a flowering plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is a plant with potential health benefits, particularly in relieving respiratory issues and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia portoricensis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, asthma, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia portoricensis include lobeline, lobelanine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
